use default

pritchard(limit: int) -> LIST[int] is
    let wheel = SET([1])

    let primes = LIST()

    let length mut = 1

    let prime mut = 2

    while prime * prime <= limit do
        if length < limit then
            extend(wheel, length, prime, limit)

            length = System.Math.min(length * prime, limit)
        fi

        for member in wheel |> collect_list() do
            if prime * member <= length then
                wheel.remove(prime * member)
            fi
        od

        primes.add(prime)

        prime = next_member(wheel, length)
    od

    for member in wheel |> sort() do
        if member > 1 /\ member <= limit then
            primes.add(member)
        fi
    od

    primes

        while step <= target do
            wheel.add(step)
